coordinates.note: The hall position is derived by multilateration from OpenStreetMap reactor-building footprints and the baselines in the RENO technical design report; the method is described in the geometry record. It is shown as approximate, not as a surveyed hall point. It replaces a campus point about 1.1 km away (35.415, 126.42389; 3 km precision).

summary.plain: A hall close to the Hanbit nuclear reactors in South Korea, holding RENO's near detector.
summary.technical: RENO near-detector hall, 294 m from the Hanbit reactor-array center.
